barka.title: Barka II Plant
barka.text: SMN Barka is an IWPP plant situated at Barka. The site is approximately 50 km northwest of Muscat, Oman.

rusail.title: Al Rusail Plant
rusail.text: Al Rusail is a gas-fired power plant in the Rusail Industrial Estate, approximately 45 km from Muscat, Oman.
